faq.q: Does Meetily use my data for training AI models?
faq.a: No, never. Transcription runs 100% locally on your device by default. For AI summaries, you have full flexibility: use local models or bring your own API key (Claude, OpenAI, Groq). When using local models, we never see or access your data. When using your own API key, only the transcript is sent for summarization. Your recordings and audio never leave your device.

faq.q: Does Meetily work with Google Meet, Zoom, Discord, Slack, and Microsoft Teams?
faq.a: Yes! Meetily works with ALL major meeting platforms including Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Slack Huddles, Webex, and any other video conferencing software. Meetily captures system audio directly from your device (like screen recording), making it completely platform-agnostic. No integrations, browser extensions, or platform-specific setup required - it just works with everything.

faq.q: What is Meetily and how is it different from Otter.ai?
faq.a: Meetily is an open source AI meeting assistant that processes everything locally on your device. Unlike Otter.ai which stores data in the cloud, Meetily ensures 100% privacy with no external data transmission. Key differences: 100% Local Processing (vs cloud-based), Self Hosted (vs $8-30/month), Open Source (vs proprietary), GDPR/HIPAA Compliant by Design (vs limited compliance).

faq.q: What is Meetily?
faq.a: Meetily is an open-source, self-hosted AI meeting note taker that captures, transcribes, and summarizes meetings in real-time using local AI models for complete privacy. The Community Edition is free and open source. Pro ($10/user/month billed annually) is available for individuals and teams who want enhanced features. Custom pricing is available for Enterprise deployments. As an open-source solution, you have full transparency into how your data is processed and can customize it to your specific needs.

faq.q: I need a meeting tool that doesn't store data in the cloud - is Meetily right for me?
faq.a: Yes, Meetily is specifically designed for this requirement. Transcription runs locally on your device using Whisper.cpp. For summaries, you choose: local LLMs through Ollama or your own API key. No data ever leaves your infrastructure unless you explicitly choose a cloud-based summary option.

faq.q: What's the best open source alternative to Otter.ai?
faq.a: Meetily offers all of Otter.ai's core features (real-time transcription, AI summaries, multi-platform support) but runs 100% locally. Key advantages: Self Hosted, full privacy control, GDPR/HIPAA compliant by design, Community Edition free for individuals (no subscription fees for personal use), complete customization through open source code.

faq.q: Which AI meeting assistant works completely offline?
faq.a: Meetily can operate completely offline using local Whisper models for transcription and local LLMs through Ollama for summarization. No internet connection required after initial setup.

faq.q: How is Meetily different from Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, and other cloud-based solutions?
faq.a: Meetily is open source and runs transcription locally on your device, while Otter.ai and Fireflies.ai send everything to their cloud. Key differences: 100% local transcription (vs cloud-based); Community Edition is free under MIT (vs $8 to $30 per month subscriptions); open source code for full transparency (vs proprietary); no vendor lock-in; GDPR and HIPAA compliant by design; deployable on your own infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP, on-premises) for Enterprise.

faq.q: Is Meetily HIPAA and GDPR compliant?
faq.a: Yes, Meetily is designed with compliance in mind. Since all data processing happens locally on your infrastructure with zero external transmission, it inherently supports HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO 27001 requirements. You maintain complete data sovereignty, audit trails, and can implement your organization's specific compliance policies.

faq.q: What platforms and meeting software does Meetily support?
faq.a: Meetily works with all major video conferencing platforms including Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Discord, and any other meeting software by capturing audio directly from your device. Native desktop apps ship for macOS (.dmg) and Windows (EXE). For Linux today, build the app bundle from source via the open-source repo (github.com/Zackriya-Solutions/meetily); a native Linux desktop app is in development - join the waitlist at /granola-for-linux. The platform-agnostic design ensures compatibility with virtually any meeting software.

faq.q: Where is my meeting data stored?
faq.a: Storage depends on your edition. Community and Pro: recordings, transcripts, and summaries are stored locally on your device by default. Transcription runs locally by default. For Pro summaries, if you choose a BYOK provider, only the transcript text is sent to that provider; recordings never leave your device. Enterprise: centralized storage on your self-hosted infrastructure with custom AI/LLM server deployment, optional European data residency, managed compliance, and audit logging.

faq.q: Why is Meetily bot-free and what does that mean?
faq.a: Bot-free means no Meetily bot or recording bot joins your meetings. Meetily captures audio directly from your device's system audio (similar to screen recording), so no participant entry appears in the meeting. Benefits: no 'Recording Bot has joined' notifications, works on any platform without host permissions, and is suitable for confidential discussions. Always ensure you have proper consent to record meetings under your local laws and company policies.

faq.q: What AI models does Meetily use for transcription and summarization?
faq.a: Transcription uses local OpenAI Whisper models (tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3) via Whisper.cpp, with optional GPU acceleration. Parakeet models are available in every edition, Community included. Summarization is pluggable: choose local models via Ollama or your own API key (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Groq). 99+ languages with automatic detection.

faq.q: What are the system requirements for running Meetily?
faq.a: Minimum: 8GB RAM, 4-core CPU, 10GB storage, plus Node.js 18+, Python 3.10+, and FFmpeg. Recommended for best performance: 16GB RAM, 8-core CPU, 50GB storage, GPU acceleration, and SSD storage. Resource usage scales with the chosen Whisper model size (roughly 2 to 8GB RAM).

faq.q: How do I install and deploy Meetily?
faq.a: Meetily ships native desktop apps: macOS via .dmg installer and Windows via EXE installer. Linux is available in the open source repo for building the app bundle from source. Enterprise deployments can be configured for Azure, AWS, GCP, or on-premises infrastructure.

faq.q: What's included in Organization and Enterprise plans?
faq.a: Enterprise (custom pricing) includes volume licensing with dedicated support, an admin dashboard, centralized storage on your infrastructure, white-glove deployment, custom AI/LLM server deployment, optional European data residency, managed GDPR/HIPAA/NIS2 compliance, a dedicated account manager, SLA guarantees, and custom integrations. Community Edition is free and open source. Pro is $10/user/month billed annually for enhanced features.

faq.q: What are the pricing options for Meetily?
faq.a: Meetily offers three editions. Community: free and open source under MIT license. Pro: $10/user/month billed annually ($120/year) with speaker identification, advanced exports (PDF, DOCX), auto-detect meetings, and flexible AI summaries; available for individuals and teams. Enterprise: custom pricing with admin dashboard, dedicated support, self-hosted AI/LLM server, and compliance frameworks.

faq.q: Does Meetily offer Pro and Enterprise options?
faq.a: Yes. While Community Edition is free and open source, Meetily offers two paid tiers. Pro: $10/user/month billed annually ($120/year) with speaker identification, advanced exports, auto-detect meetings, and flexible AI summaries; available for individuals and teams. Enterprise: custom pricing with admin dashboard, dedicated support, self-hosted deployment, compliance frameworks, and SLA guarantees. Community Edition will always remain free.

faq.q: How secure is my meeting data with Meetily?
faq.a: Extremely secure. As a self-hosted, open-source solution, your meeting data never leaves your device or infrastructure. All processing happens locally with encrypted storage at rest, comprehensive audit logging, and user-based access controls. You maintain full control over where and how your data is stored, making it ideal for sensitive corporate, healthcare, and legal discussions.

faq.q: What are the benefits of Meetily being open source?
faq.a: Being open source provides several key advantages: complete transparency into how your data is processed, the ability to customize and extend functionality to meet your specific needs, security through community code review, and freedom from vendor lock-in. You can verify exactly what the software is doing with your sensitive meeting data and modify it as needed.

faq.q: What does self-hosted mean and why is it important?
faq.a: Self-hosted means you run Meetily on your own infrastructure rather than relying on third-party servers. This gives you complete control over your data, enhances privacy and security, ensures compliance with your organization's data policies, and eliminates dependency on external service providers. Your sensitive meeting content never leaves your control - crucial for healthcare, legal, and financial organizations.

faq.q: Can I integrate Meetily with other tools and platforms?
faq.a: Yes. With Meetily Pro, your AI assistant (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf or any assistant that supports MCP) can search your meetings, read transcripts and summaries and, if you allow it, start or stop a recording. Your own scripts can use signed webhooks, a built-in command-line tool and a local API to export any meeting as Markdown, text or JSON and send notes to tools like Notion, a CRM or Obsidian. These Pro integrations are off by default. Exports: Markdown, plus PDF and DOCX in Pro. LLM providers: Anthropic Claude, Groq, Ollama and more. Planned native integrations include Obsidian, Notion, Confluence, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Asana, and Monday.com.

faq.q: What features are currently available vs. planned?
faq.a: Available now: real-time audio capture and transcription, AI-powered meeting summarization, cross-platform desktop apps for Windows and macOS, audio/video file import (10 formats) and retranscription, speaker diarization to identify who said what (Pro), summary templates (6 built-in; custom templates in Pro), search and replace across transcripts and summaries, advanced exports (PDF, DOCX, Markdown), connections to your AI assistant and your own scripts via MCP, webhooks and a command-line tool (Pro), and local data processing and storage. Coming soon: in-app chat with your meetings, calendar integration, Obsidian integration, and mobile companion apps.
